name: website-quality
description: Evidence-led website QA: find layout, responsive, accessibility, metadata and runtime defects on any rendered site, compare a build with specific Figma nodes, and explain engine-specific symptoms.

interface.shortDescription: Find what is broken on a rendered site, and what the next edit will break
interface.longDescription: Drives a real browser across every breakpoint and every width between them, measuring geometry, fit, collisions and headroom; predicts what a longer word, a missing image or 200% text zoom would break; names the CSS declaration responsible; and reports each finding with the evidence class that earned it. Works on any rendered site — platform knowledge is optional and additive.
defaultPrompt: QA this URL and tell me what a visitor loses
Does this layout break at any width between the breakpoints?
What will break the next time an editor changes this page?
Compare this page with its Figma nodes at 1512 and 393
